about: check-size.mts --budgets: gzip bytes the browser downloads, per class, from dist/ after npm run build. A size over its budget fails; a size more than 5% under fails until the budget is lowered, so budgets only go down. Set 2026-11-04 from the fork's main at about 1% over the measured size. boot raised by 50 bytes on 2026-11-05 (1,168,020 to 1,168,070) for a context-restore correctness fix that the headroom left could not hold: engine.contextLost also reads gl.isContextLost(), and the engine skips initTexture and warmDraw while the context is lost (Captain-approved exception).
